channel.title: PolyPDF Guides and Product Notes
channel.description: Practical guides for measuring, reviewing, securing, and preparing PDF drawings with PolyPDF.

item.title: How to Calibrate a PDF Drawing Scale
item.description: Set an accurate PDF drawing scale from a printed ratio or a known dimension, then check it against a second reference before starting takeoff.

item.title: Why PDF Measurements Are Wrong (and How to Fix Them)
item.description: Diagnose bad PDF dimensions by checking page scale, units, endpoints, detail regions, and scan distortion in a deliberate order.

item.title: How to Measure PDF Area with Cutouts and Depth
item.description: Trace a net PDF area, subtract multiple interior openings, optionally convert it to volume with depth, and keep hatch styling separate from the math.

item.title: PDF Takeoff Worked Example: Scale, Area, Length, and Count
item.description: Follow one small plan takeoff from calibration through area, wall lengths, diffuser count, worksheet review, and CSV or PDF export.

item.title: How to Count Symbols in a PDF Drawing
item.description: Use PolyPDF Pro Symbol Search to find repeated plan symbols, review every candidate, and commit the accepted matches as one linked Count series.

item.title: Use a PDF Markup Table for RFI and Punch-List Review
item.description: Turn drawing markups into a filterable review register, with clear subjects, comments, statuses, and exports for an existing RFI or punch-list process.

item.title: How to Compare PDF Drawing Revisions
item.description: Compare a baseline PDF with a revised file, review the detected regions, and issue a separate comparison record without overwriting the source.

item.title: How to Create a Fillable PDF Form
item.description: Add standard AcroForm fields to a compatible PDF, set names and tab order, test the saved copy, and recognize signed, secured, and XFA limits.

item.title: How to OCR Scanned PDF Drawings
item.description: Add a best-effort searchable text layer to scanned PDF drawings, then test search results and verify every value that could affect field or estimating work.

item.title: Digital vs Visual PDF Signatures vs Professional Seals
item.description: Understand what a certificate-backed PDF signature verifies, what a visual signature mark does not, and why a professional seal is graphic artwork rather than a cryptographic signature.

item.title: How to Redact and Sanitize a PDF: Limits to Know
item.description: Use PolyPDF redaction for supported searchable text, understand what sanitation can miss, and independently inspect the saved copy before release.

item.title: How to Prepare an Issued PDF Set
item.description: Build a repeatable issue workflow with page labels, visible Bates identifiers, headers and footers, watermarks, preflight, and final-viewer checks.

item.title: Set Up PolyPDF Collaboration Beta
item.description: PolyPDF Collaboration keeps the PDF on your company share while approved Mac and Windows users exchange live markups, cursors, offline edits, and signed history through a customer-owned host.

item.title: Introducing PolyPDF Plugins
item.description: How PolyPDF Pro plugins work: declarative packages, one-list management, sideload consent, host-owned generators, and the three generators that come with the app.
